Sandbox_MVR_Enabled_tooltip: Turns the whole mod on or off.
Sandbox_MVR_ConditionGainMultiplier_tool: Scales how much condition a successful repair restores. Default 1.
Sandbox_MVR_CapOffset_tooltip: Added to every repair cap. Improvised repairs never go above 75/78/80 (patch/repair/overhaul) nor below 30. Default 0.
Sandbox_MVR_SevereFailEnabled_tooltip: When on, 40% of failures cost 20 condition instead of 5.
Sandbox_MVR_SideEffectsEnabled_tooltip: Hand cuts/burns, tool wear, wasted material and frustration.
Sandbox_MVR_InjuryChanceMultiplier_toolt: Scales cut and burn chances. Gloves already reduce them. Default 1.
Sandbox_MVR_XPMultiplier_tooltip: Base XP: 3 success, 5 great success, 1 failure, once per part per vehicle per game day. Default 1.
Sandbox_MVR_TimeMultiplier_tooltip: Scales how long repairs take. Default 1.
Sandbox_MVR_PatchHistoryEnabled_tooltip: Each successful improvised repair lowers that part cap by 3 (minimum 30) until the part is replaced.
Sandbox_MVR_WorkshopBonusEnabled_tooltip: Vehicle indoors: -3 points of failure chance. Darkness: +5. Jack: tires, brakes and suspension 15% faster.
Sandbox_MVR_QualityTiersEnabled_tooltip: Adds Repair (Mechanics 3) and Overhaul (Mechanics 6) with higher caps, more materials and time. Off = Patch only.
